dialogues.speaker: Alodia
dialogues.text: Aside from the ones commonly found in Mondstadt, some are new varieties carefully cultivated by Miss Lilian.

dialogues.speaker: Alodia
dialogues.text: Because they're unique to Millhaven, even Miss Flora from Mondstadt sometimes comes here to buy them. Hmm, speaking of which, I really should send her some more for the next Windblume Festival...

dialogues.speaker: Alodia
dialogues.text: Anyway, having a few flowers around the house really lifts the mood. I'm sure their beautiful colors and rich fragrance will help you feel a bit more relaxed.
